items.title: Why this startup is taking its AI to predict breast cancer risk directly to patients
items.excerpt: Clairity, maker of an FDA-authorized AI that predicts five-year breast cancer risk from a standard mammogram, is now selling the test directly to consumers (via Everlywell, $249) instead of waiting for health systems to adopt it.

history_match.title: Clairity expands access to AI breast cancer risk tool via Everlywell

items.title: Why health AI pilots in Utah may be on a collision course with the FDA
items.excerpt: Utah's regulatory sandbox now lets AI tools draft care plans and manage prescriptions with reduced physician oversight; STAT examines why those state-sanctioned pilots may conflict with FDA device rules.

history_match.title: Utah approves slew of health AI pilots for drug management, women's health

items.title: Claude analyzed my genome in 30 minutes. Now we need standards for the results
items.excerpt: Stanford cardiologist-geneticist Euan Ashley describes an LLM interpreting his whole genome in 30 minutes for about $5 and argues clinical genomics needs validation standards before patients rely on such AI reads.

items.title: Data privacy concerns could hold patients back from using AI
items.excerpt: A patient survey finds growing concern about how health data is handled by AI tools, which could limit uptake of AI in care even as use in daily life rises.

items.title: AI Can Flag Cognitive Decline Earlier — Health Systems Still Own What Happens Next
items.excerpt: AI that flags early cognitive decline in the EHR creates a clinical duty to act; health systems must define follow-up pathways, referrals and accountability once the alert fires.

items.title: Teladoc Health Adds Contactless Vitals and Ambient AI Scribe to Virtual Visit Platform
items.excerpt: Teladoc is building camera-based contactless vitals and an ambient AI scribe into its Solo virtual care platform used by hospitals and health systems for telehealth visits.

history_match.title: Teladoc unveils remote monitoring, ambient AI features

items.title: Weekly Rundown: Nextech taps Assort Health, EliseAI for agentic AI; Elsevier rolls out clinical AI tool for nurses
items.excerpt: Health AI briefs for Oct. 5-9, including Elsevier's clinical AI tool for nurses and agentic AI deployments in specialty practices.

items.title: Governments selling patient data are “betraying” their people, says AI expert
items.excerpt: HealthAI CEO Ricardo Baptista Leite urged governments not to buy or sell patient data for AI, warning of a power imbalance with AI companies, as pressure mounts on NHS England over its Palantir data contract.

items.title: An open vision-language model for diverse medical applications
items.excerpt: MedGemma, open medical vision-language models built on Gemma 3, are evaluated across imaging domains and clinical text tasks, outperforming similarly sized generative models.

items.title: Accuracy of a respiratory assessment chatbot in a nationwide messaging system for layperson diagnosis and triage: a randomized preregistered study
items.excerpt: In a preregistered randomized study of 2,400 laypeople, a GPT-4o-based chatbot inside WeChat improved accuracy in diagnosing and triaging respiratory conditions across 88 clinical vignettes.
